title: Water Damage Mitigation Credit Terms Schedule: Deposit, Payment Terms, Late Fees and Card Surcharge
content:
Water Damage Mitigation credit terms are set per tier: the self-pay deposit, the payment terms after the final invoice for self-pay and insurance-funded jobs, the late fee percentage, minimum and grace days, the claim-pending late fee suspension period and the credit card surcharge.

| Tier | Self-pay deposit | Self-pay terms (days) | Insurance terms (days) | Late fee per monthly period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $500.00 | 15 | 45 | 1.5 percent |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $1500.00 | 15 | 45 | 1.5 percent |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $750.00 | 15 | 45 | 1.5 percent |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $2000.00 | 15 | 45 | 1.5 percent |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $1000.00 | 15 | 45 | 1.5 percent |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $2500.00 | 15 | 45 | 1.5 percent |

| Tier | Late fee minimum | Grace days | Claim-pending suspension (days) | Credit card surcharge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $25.00 | 10 | 90 | 2.95 percent |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $25.00 | 10 | 90 | 2.95 percent |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $25.00 | 10 | 90 | 2.95 percent |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $25.00 | 10 | 90 | 2.95 percent |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $25.00 | 10 | 90 | 2.95 percent |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $25.00 | 10 | 90 | 2.95 percent |

## Schedule definitions
- **Self-pay deposit**: Deposit a self-pay customer pays before drying equipment is set, USD.
- **Self-pay terms**: Days after the final invoice date by which a self-pay balance is due, calendar days.
- **Insurance terms**: Days after the final invoice date by which an insurance-funded balance is due, calendar days.
- **Late fee**: Late fee on the past-due balance per monthly fee period, percent.
- **Late fee minimum**: Minimum late fee per monthly fee period, USD.
- **Grace days**: Grace days after the due date before the first late fee may post, calendar days.
- **Claim-pending suspension**: Days after the final invoice date during which late fees are suspended on an insurance-funded job whose claim file is still awaiting carrier payment, calendar days.
- **Credit card surcharge**: Surcharge on payments made by credit card (never debit card, ACH or check), percent.

## Notes
- Only the self-pay deposit varies by tier; every other term in this schedule is the same on all six tiers.
